label: Solutions
seo_description: Buyer-world solutions for private schools, international schools, K-12 schools, faith-based schools, multi-campus groups, and growing school networks.
headline: Solutions aligned to the school you operate.
subheadline: Choose the buyer world closest to your operating model, then inspect the workflows, visuals, modules, trust notes, and rollout path built for it.

faqs.question: How do solutions relate to the platform?
faqs.answer: The platform is one governed stack; solutions describe the school operating models you care about first.

faqs.question: Do buyer worlds still cover offline operations?
faqs.answer: Yes. Offline-first workflows remain a platform differentiator and can be evaluated inside the school model that matches your rollout.

faqs.question: How do multi-campus groups stay aligned?
faqs.answer: Networks get operator visibility and standards without forcing every campus into the same workflow.

faqs.question: Can each school keep its own domain?
faqs.answer: Yes. Tenant-scoped routing and branding keep boundaries explicit for each school.
